title: Crestline Companion Refund Processing Charge: Co-Brand Card Waiver
content:
The refund processing charge on a companion taxes-and-fees refund under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes is reduced by a co-brand card waiver. The waiver follows the miles credited to the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program by co-brand card partner accrual entries dated in the last 12 months, counted back from the handling date.

| Miles from co-brand card partner accrual entries in the last 12 months | Co-brand card waiver of the refund processing charge |
|---|---|
| 60000 or more | 40 percent |
| 25000 to fewer than 60000 | 20 percent |
| fewer than 25000 | none |

Only partner accrual entries from the co-brand card count; flight accruals and accruals from other partners do not.

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** Exactly 60000 miles gives 40 percent and 59999 gives 20 percent; exactly 25000 gives 20 percent and 24999 gives none.
